tasks.short: Advise physicians on radioactive-material applications, limitations and risks.

steps.what: Review the clinical question and current relevant nuclear medicine source records
Advise physicians on actual radioactive-material indications, limitations, assessments and diagnostic or therapeutic risks
Write and check actual advice, limitations and agreed follow-up in the consultation record
Save the checked actual physician advice note

tasks.design: Configure native clinical-context and selected reference links in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, and {DOCS}. Retain source reading, physician advice and actual outcome writing; save the checked note separately without a generated radiation recommendation or an unperformed treatment order.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actual question and relevant current sources may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can reduce retrieval without interpreting radiation risks.
tasks.still_hard: Indications and risks depend on the actual patient and proposed application.
tasks.human_edge: The radiologist explains uncertainty and practical limits to the referring physician.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; advice authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical and document links can expose current sources without determining nuclear medicine indications.

assumptions: Boundary is actual physician consultation and its short actual note, not procedure execution.

The referring physician supplies the actual question and prior clinical work supplies patient findings. The radiologist selects and verifies context and current source revisions in s1; missing sources require manual retrieval in retained time.
Actual conclusions only arise during s2 and are captured in s3. No free transcript, structured advice record or additional report is assumed.
Shares are provisional. Test native links first; existing configuration earns no benefit. The existing note check covers its fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
research_questions: Does the native consultation view remove repeated source navigation without altering advice?

incremental.description: Check nuclear medicine reference links and revisions

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked actual physician advice note with qualifications and follow-up

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional ten-unit retrieval step at 50 percent saves five points minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible retrieval gives two. Actual advice, outcome writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate, measure and prepare the authorised radioisotope dosage.

steps.what: Verify the actual patient, authorised radioisotope order and applicable preparation protocol
Measure actual radioisotope activity and verify measurement time, units and material identity
Calculate the required preparation using measured activity and the validated protocol
Check the complete calculated dosage instruction against the order, measurement and protocol
Physically prepare the radioisotope dosage according to the checked final instruction
Write and check the actual measured and prepared dosage, timing and source record
Save the checked actual radioisotope dosage preparation record

tasks.design: Use validated native dosage arithmetic in {OTHER}, the nuclear medicine preparation application, from separately measured actual activity and the authorised protocol. Keep patient/order checks, physical measurement, complete instruction verification, preparation and actual record writing human; separately save the checked result without selecting a dose or administering material to a patient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated protocol arithmetic may be performed manually after actual activity measurement.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated native calculators can apply explicit approved arithmetic without changing prescribing or preparation decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Material identity, measurement time, unit consistency and actual preparation require direct verification.
tasks.human_edge: The radiologist recognises inconsistent measured values and remains responsible within actual preparation authority.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; dose selection and physical preparation authority are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: validated nuclear medicine applications can perform explicit dosage and activity arithmetic under approved protocols; actual measurement and preparation remain separate work.

assumptions: Boundary is a radiologist actually authorised and responsible for this calculation, measurement and preparation. If local practice assigns physical preparation to another profession, reassign and measure its labour before using this focal scenario.

The authorised clinician supplies the actual order; protocol owners supply validated arithmetic and parameters. s2 includes actual measurement and capture of material ID, measured activity, units, measurement time and required preparation context. Missing, inconsistent or stale values require manual resolution before s3.
Use validated native functions before custom code. No generative model chooses activity or formula. Only repeated human arithmetic changes; existing calculator runtime earns no saving.

Shares are provisional. The complete final calculation exists before s4 verification and s5 physical preparation. Actual preparation is recorded only afterwards; ordinary final record checking covers the fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
unknowns: Local role ownership and actual preparation authority
research_questions: Does a verified workflow sample show repeated human arithmetic that the validated native function removes?

incremental.description: Check protocol and calculation-version changes and investigate incompatible inputs

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final dosage preparation instruction bound to order material measurement and time
s6 complete checked actual measured and prepared dosage record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional repeated dosage arithmetic saves 15 points minus 1.5 upkeep = 13.5. Half eligible arithmetic gives 7.5 minus 1.5 = six. Order checking, actual measurement, verification, physical preparation, actual recording and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check and approve diagnostic image quality before patient discharge.

steps.what: Review the examination request, acquired series and actual image acquisition metadata
Inspect actual diagnostic images for coverage, artefacts and adequacy for the clinical question
Approve actual diagnostic image quality or require further acquisition before patient discharge
Enter and check the actual quality decision, limitations and required further acquisition
Commit the checked actual diagnostic image quality decision

tasks.design: Configure native request, series and acquisition-metadata display in {OTHER}, the image archive and viewer, to reduce navigation. Keep actual image inspection and the quality approval decision fully human, then enter and commit the actual checked decision separately; displaying metadata does not approve an image or discharge a patient.
tasks.previous_blocker: The request and acquisition details may require separate viewer navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native viewer layouts can show existing metadata beside the actual acquired series.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical adequacy and artefacts require image-specific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The radiologist determines whether actual images answer the clinical question before the patient leaves.
tasks.altitude: Less viewer navigation; image quality approval remains the radiologists responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native image-viewer layouts can display examination requests and acquisition metadata; this is distinct from automated image quality judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is actual diagnostic image quality approval and its entry before discharge, not the discharge action itself or final diagnostic reporting.

Imaging equipment and prior acquisition work supply actual series IDs, acquisition time, parameters and examination linkage. The radiologist verifies patient and series match in s1; missing metadata requires manual checking there.
No visual classifier or model changes the inspection step. Native viewer configuration is tested first; existing layouts earn no benefit.

Shares are provisional. s3 is the quality approval explicitly required by the task; s4 is ordinary entry accuracy, not invented self-approval. Its separate fully retained 1 percent commit is schema granularity.
research_questions: Does native layout configuration remove navigation while retaining complete actual image inspection?

incremental.description: Check viewer layout changes and examination-link exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked actual image quality decision and patient-series linkage

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional ten-unit context navigation at 50 percent saves five points minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible navigation gives two. Actual image inspection, quality approval, actual entry and commit retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare nuclear medicine with other diagnostic imaging procedures.

steps.what: Define the actual clinical question and relevant patient or procedure constraints
Locate current nuclear medicine, CT, ultrasound, MRI and angiography procedure sources
Read and compare nuclear medicine procedures with other modalities for the actual clinical question
Write and check actual comparative benefits, limitations and source-qualified conclusions
Save the checked actual procedure comparison note

tasks.design: Configure native indication, modality and revision filters in {DOCS}, the controlled procedure library. Keep actual source reading and comparative clinical judgement human, then write and separately save the checked conclusion without selecting or booking a patient procedure automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant current procedure sources can require repeated manual finding across modalities.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source indexes can shorten retrieval without supplying a clinical ranking.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnostic value, contraindications and practical tradeoffs depend on the actual question and patient.
tasks.human_edge: The radiologist compares evidence and limitations beyond a generic modality table.
tasks.altitude: Less source finding; clinical modality decisions remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native controlled-document indexes can filter procedure references by modality, indication and revision without assessing clinical appropriateness.

assumptions: Boundary is actual comparative assessment and its short conclusion note, not scheduling, patient consent or procedure execution.

Protocol owners provide dated controlled sources and metadata; the radiologist defines the actual comparison in s1 and verifies source fit in s2. Missing metadata requires manual retrieval within retained effort.
Source reading, actual judgement and fresh writing retain full effort. Native filters precede custom tooling; existing indexes earn no new benefit.
Shares are provisional. The existing note accuracy check covers the separate fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
research_questions: Can the native source index expose current comparable procedures without obscuring exceptions?

incremental.description: Check procedure source metadata and obsolete revisions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked actual procedure comparison with source-qualified limits

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 20-unit source finding at 50 percent saves ten points minus one upkeep = nine. Half eligible retrieval gives four. Actual question definition, source reading, clinical comparison, writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less verified source retrieval and explicit dosage arithmetic; clinical judgement, actual preparation and quality approval remain human.
skills_to_grow: Validate native dosage calculation inputs and versions
Preserve actual preparation and quality decision records
role.ambitious_version: A radiologist who prepares reliable source-linked work while retaining actual clinical decisions and physical verification.
